ak48.description_en: Since the mid-90s, AK varieties have become increasingly popular. Our AK-48 is one of the strongest, earliest flowering varieties available. The plants produce hard buds with an exceptional, pungent aroma. Although AK-48 is a hybrid of Indica and Sativa, its high effect is more similar to Sativa. While most growers would opt for a longer growth phase, under perfect conditions it is possible to make AK-48 ready for harvest in just 48 days.

bizcocho.description_en: The cookie-dominant phenotype of Bizcocho offers an exceptionally complex and deep flavor profile, particularly interesting for lovers of sweet, gassy strains. The effects of Bizcocho are long-lasting and combine mental clarity with physical relaxation, ideal for various activities or unwinding.

blue-gelato-41.description_en: Blue Gelato 41 is our sensational Blueberry supercross from the West Coast. It was created by crossing the famous Blueberry genetics with Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies and the fresh-fruity Indica Sunset Sherbet. Blue Gelato 41 quickly pulls you into a sea of deep psychedelic relaxation. The buds of this strain are resinous and exude a sweet-earthy lemon scent, with many phenotypes appearing blue to purple in color.

bubble-og.description_en: BUBBLE OG by LITFARMS is a cross between Bubble Bath (The Soap x Project 4516) x LIT OG. By mixing the minty-soapy nuances of The Soap and the Zkittlez notes from Project 4516 combined with OG-heavy notes containing gas and pastry tones on the finish, a completely new blend emerges.

double-rainbow-sherb.description_en: RS-11 is an Indica-dominant hybrid created by crossing Pink Guava x OZK. Lemon Cherry Gelato offers an amazing taste and an effect that will put you in pure bliss. This bud has a flavor that matches exactly what its name suggests – sour lemons paired with rich cherries and berries.

gorilla-blueberry.description_en: A powerful cross between the legendary Gorilla Glue and the fruity Blueberry.

jelly-donutz.description_en: The effect is initially clear, creative, and activating before transitioning into a pleasant physical relaxation. With very high THC levels, Jelly Donutz is one of the more potent strains in the CSCN portfolio, while remaining pleasantly balanced.

platinum-kush.description_en: Platinum Kush Breath from In-House is Platinum x OGKB V2.1. It looks fantastic, smells like a muted hash-gas aroma, and has a grounding effect. Platinum is reportedly an old-school cross of UW Hashplant and Permafrost.

pnw-cherries.description_en: PNW Cherries produces a balanced, rather clear, head-heavy effect. It starts with a cerebral high that is creativity-enhancing and mood-boosting. In the further course, a pleasant body feeling can set in.

sugar-cane.description_en: The effect sets in with an uplifting cerebral high that clears the mind and stimulates creativity. As the high progresses, a soothing physical relaxation occurs that does not lead to being couch-locked.
